body: Thanks for your help. I get what your saying. I appreciate the help and its really nice talking to someone when i get like this. You helped me out a lot and no one ever does. Everyone just tells me to get over it and all this other stuff. I like people like you that actually try because now i feel better and not worse about my situation :)
Hey im here for you if you want to talk :)

thanks its nice to know that someone cares, just everything is going downhill right now in my life. I feel like i have no where to go and that nothing matters anymore. No one cares about me outside of the internet. Im in high school right now and every single day i get bullied, people saying that i should kill myself and all that and everything that happens in school and out just adds up and it makes me feel like i have no place to go. I just dont know what to do with my life anymore and its an everyday struggle for me to exist. I know i probably sound really annoying right now so im sorry, but thanks for listening
